title: Field blocks for Bavaria, Germany
description:
This dataset contains the field blocks ("Feldstücke") of Bavaria, the reference parcels of its Land
Parcel Identification System (LPIS). A Feldstück is a contiguous agricultural area belonging to a
single farm operator; areas separated by roads, tracks or watercourses are not combined, and
differing tenure, use or fertiliser planning do not split one. Delineation follows the area eligible
for support, which comprises agricultural area, agriculturally usable area and eligible landscape
elements. The data is published in the "IACS in INSPIRE" (TG2) data model and republished twice a
year for the application procedure.

This collection holds 1 edition (2026), one GeoParquet file per year under `year=<year>/` (hive layout). Read them all at once with the partition glob `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_by_block/year=*/*.parquet` (S3 through the Source Cooperative proxy, endpoint `https://data.source.coop`; plain https cannot expand `*`); the `data` asset is a copy of the latest edition (2026). Geometries are kept in the source CRS (EPSG:25832). Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) into the [fiboa](https://github.com/fiboa/specification) schema; tested queries are in the collection's [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_by_block/AGENTS.md).

Boundaries are declared: they come from farmers' subsidy applications, or from the parcel register built on those declarations.

providers.name: Bayerisches Staatsministerium für Ernährung, Landwirtschaft, Forsten und Tourismus

table:columns.name: crop:name
table:columns.description: Crop name in the original language. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/crop-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: flik
table:columns.description: The area identifier (FLIK code) is a 16-character string. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/flik-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: crop:code
table:columns.description: The crop code, from the code list of the source. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/crop-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: determination:datetime
table:columns.description: The last timestamp at which the field did exist and was observed. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

partition:keys.name: year
partition:keys.description: Edition year of the source dataset (the converter variant). Not a column in the files; DuckDB adds it with hive_partitioning=true. Expand the glob through S3 (endpoint data.source.coop, path style); plain https has no listing.

data.title: Germany, Bavaria (blocks) — latest edition (2026) (GeoParquet)
data.description: Byte-identical copy of `year=2026/de_by_block.parquet`, kept at a stable path so `*/latest/*.parquet` selects the newest edition of every collection.

style-field-size.title: Field size (ha)
style-field-size.description: Fields shaded light to dark by area in hectares (metrics:area / 10 000). Stops at 0.5, 1, 2 ha, the nice values nearest this dataset's 20th/40th/60th/80th percentiles so each class holds a similar share of fields.

style-outline.title: Field boundaries
style-outline.description: Every field in one colour with a thin outline; for reading the boundaries themselves.

thumbnail.title: Preview of the collection's default style.
